text:
Aditi: Hi @Marcus 1 Welcome to Redwood! Dropping a bite-sized manager onboarding checklist so you can hit the ground running. Post blockers here.

Marcus: Thanks! Quick asks: when do I get my laptop, who approves API keys, and is there a 30/60/90 template?

Aditi: Laptop usually ships within 48h after the IT form. API keys need product + security approval (raise request, include justification). Template: https://docs.redwood.ai/templates/manager-90-day (start simple).

Tara (IT): @Marcus please run the asset request: 
```
/asset-request --user marcus --item laptop --pref m3
```
Add phone number for Duo. If urgent, mark priority=high.

Noah (Security): To get elevated roles we need: Security 101, Accept Access Policy, and a short justification for the role. Expect ~1-2 business days for approvals. Tip: request read-only first. :lock:

Riley: I'll block 30m team intros on Day 1 and share the team org map + owners doc. Also sending a starter 30/60/90 draft that aligns with Eng OKRs.

Marcus: What's a realistic week 1 milestone I should set with my manager?

Aditi: Week 1 milestone suggestions:
- Complete accounts + Duo + laptop setup (Day 0)
- Meet direct reports + schedule 1:1s (Day 1)
- Read key runbooks + shadow on-call (Day 2)
- Draft 30/60/90 and align with manager (Day 3)
- Identify 1 small process to own in first 30d (Day 4)
Make milestones measurable and add owners.

onboarding-bot: Welcome folder created for Marcus: https://drive.redwood.ai/onboarding/marcus-kit :tada:

Tara (IT): If you need service-specific roles, include the service name (ex: redis-prod), exact scope, and ticket link in the request form to speed things up.

Noah (Security): Reminder: enable disk encryption and register device in MDM during first setup. If using personal device for access, request exception via security-exceptions form.

Marcus: Filing IT request now and starting the security trainings. I'll reply here with updates. Appreciate the quick help!

Aditi: Great. If anything stalls, tag me and we'll escalate in the ops sync. We'll run a calibration check of your 30/60/90 at week 4. :calendar:
